BIOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Specimen Collection and Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Specimen Collection and Preservation.

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transport.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Biology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Specimen Collection and Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Cell Structure and Specialisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
